description: List past USDC micropayments made by this wallet through Xenarch. Returns transaction hashes, URLs, domains, amounts in USD, timestamps, total spend, and payment count. Optionally filter by domain. Use this to audit spending, check if you already paid for a resource, or track agent expenditure.

domain.description: Filter payment history by domain (e.g. 'example.com'). Omit to return all payments across all domains.

limit.description: Maximum number of payment records to return (1-100, default 10). Use higher values to see full spending history.

name: xenarch_get_history
